analysis_kinds.oracle: the reminders module read (erp_cp7_read_reminder_conditions_v2) and read-only recheck (erp_cp7_recheck_reminder_v2) as the owner

accessory_notice.quantity: additional_external, installation and unused allocation stay UNKNOWN; gross is BOM context only
accessory_notice.current_recheck: one coherent checked_at capture after shared Native master, policy, profile, schedule and category locks
accessory_notice.dedup: same open target/category episode across analysis runs; changed/technical unknown is held, not resolved
accessory_notice.provider: actual fake CallMeBot receipt; no real WA

stock_formula.module: scripts/cp7-src/stock-formula/formula.sql (finished goods) and materials.sql (fabric, accessories); schema cp7_stock_formula, owned by cp7_capture; installed before alerts.sql
stock_formula.formula: reorder point = ceil(D x L + safety); safety = z(service level) x sigma x sqrt(L) (STATISTICAL) or D x buffer_days (DAYS, from the planning profile), never both
stock_formula.oracle: scripts/cp7_stock_formula_cases.py oracle() and material_oracle(): recomputed in Python from the fixture own days and quantities (Decimal), never from the module tables
stock_formula.fixtures: stock found at opname, sale draft and post, sale inverse, the production chain (cut, wash, QC), the planning profile, fabric receipts, Buat Potongan, fabric back from a cutting, cutting reopen, opening purchase commitments, notas mandor, factory use, nota returns credited, service post fill; all through accepted Native or CP7 commands; only masters inserted
stock_formula.not_tested_on_real_data: service level 95% has not been backtested on the owner data (none in the test environment); after CP7C

material_rules.fabric_use: CUTTING_ISSUE less CUTTING_RETURN, INTERNAL_USE, CONTRACTOR_ISSUE; an inverted movement and its inverse not counted
material_rules.accessory_use: CONTRACTOR_ISSUE (nota mandor) and INTERNAL_USE, less a nota credited back usable (BC_NOTE_RETURN_CREDIT outside the service zones)
material_rules.fabric_stock: every location; on order: remaining opening purchase commitments (erp.bb_commitment_line_remaining_v1)
material_rules.accessory_stock: active raw-material warehouses that are not a service zone (what Bahan & Roll shows on hand); no on-order source
material_rules.lead_time: per-material setting lama kirim (Owner/Admin); fabric: empty NOT_ENOUGH_DATA; accessory: one of the owner estimate numbers (D17-12)
material_rules.manual: fabric: the Kain & Benchmark minimum replaces the formula and keeps the Ringkasan Gudang rule (free stock strictly under); accessory (D17-10/D17-12): no formula; a typed minimum (0 = never), else the minimum worked out from the owner numbers (ESTIMATE = ceil 0.01 of usage_month_qty x (lead_days + buffer_days) / 30, multiplied before dividing (E25v); MOQ kept for the order), else NOT_SET (no reminder); stock <= minimum rings
material_rules.rounding: ceiling to 0.01 in the material unit (fabric formula)
material_rules.one_fabric_reminder: D17-10: fabrics on the formula (stock + on order <= point) are rows of FABRIC_BELOW_MINIMUM "Stok kain di bawah minimum" next to the fabrics under their minimum (cp7_alert_native.fabric_kind_source); Ringkasan Gudang lists the minimums only

other_obligations.amounts: Exact Native remaining strings; UNKNOWN stays unknown; unfinalised receipts never become a second AP amount. Missing due dates are review reminders, not overdue.
